instruction: Can you help me disable the 'one instance when started from file' option in VLC Media Player? I want to be able to open multiple VLC windows when double-clicking different video files.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the 'one instance when started from file' setting in VLC to allow multiple windows. The evaluator uses the existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric to verify that the setting is set to 0 (disabled). Similar difficulty to the original - navigating VLC interface preferences and unchecking a specific option.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads VLC config file (vlcrc) from OS-specific location
Metric logic correctly parses the 'one-instance-when-started-from-file' setting from config file
Metric defaults to '1' (enabled) if setting not found, then compares against expected value '0'
Expected value of 0 is semantically correct - disables the setting to allow multiple VLC windows
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure settings are saved to disk
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement - verifying the setting is disabled
Data flow is correct: getter extracts right state, metric checks right setting, expected value is accurate
